new_this_week.title: The Witness
new_this_week.about: Three-part series about the aftermath of the 1992 murder of Rachel Nickell, told from the perspective of her young son (the only witness) and his father. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes; #2 on Netflix US in its first days.
new_this_week.why: Critic darling. Heavier than your usual lane (sad drama, weighty true-crime), but the ~3-hour total runtime makes it a contained one-or-two-night watch instead of a long commitment. Try-rated, not strong.

new_this_week.title: Office Romance

new_this_week.why: Out of lane for sci-fi/horror, but a low-effort, light-tone option for a night when you don't want to think. Skip if you want substance.

critics.title: The Witness
critics.about: Three-part series on the 1992 Rachel Nickell case, told from her son's and partner's perspective. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes; hit #2 on Netflix US within 48 hours.
critics.why: Critic darling — if you're up for a weightier night, this is the most-talked-about new drama on a platform you have. Short total runtime keeps the commitment low.
